about_the_game:
The Ultimate Election Simulator

Run a complete presidential campaign, from primaries to the general election, across a living political map of the United States. Over 3,000 counties are modeled with real-world demographics, party registrations, and ideological positions, creating endless possibilities. Every rally, speech, and advertisement impacts the number of votes you'll get.

Plan Your Strategy

Plan your weekly moves and adapt to new conditions. Open field offices, build volunteer networks, buy advertisements, hire staff, and schedule events in any county and state you see fit. But don't run out of money!

Unpredictable Events

No race is the same. Debates, scandals, endorsements, and breaking news can swing the polls overnight. Your opponents will react to your tactics and counter with strategies that match their political style, strengths, and weaknesses.

Real-Life and Custom Candidates

Play as a real politician or create a custom candidate. Select unique traits and attributes that affect your campaign’s strengths and vulnerabilities. Will you charm voters as Barack Obama? Dominate the airwaves as Donald Trump? Or brutally attack your rivals with your own candidate? The choice is yours.

Dynamic Polls

Track your progress with 12 pollsters who take new polls every week. Every poll could be wildly inaccurate or right on the money. You truly won't know who's going to win until Election Day.

Election Night Drama

Experience the tension of the results coming in live, state by state, county by county. Watch the map shift in real time as votes are counted and momentum swings. Every decision you made on the trail culminates in this moment. Will you see a glorious victory? Or suffer a shocking upset?

An Election Sandbox

Play through historical scenarios with real-world data. Can you defeat Reagan as Carter? Or defeat FDR in 1940? And, predict the future in 2028 and beyond.

A Global Vision

While your journey begins in the United States, The Electorate is built for international expansion. Future updates will feature elections from the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, France, and more, each with its own political system, voter behavior, and campaign challenges.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 650 / Radeon HD 3600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
